verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of consent features such as participant recording notifications, in-meeting disclosure prompts, or admin-enforced transparency settings. The cited enterprise controls (SSO, audit trails) are adjacent security features, not consent mechanisms, and the docs promote bot-free desktop recording, which reduces participant visibility. Community reports describe after-the-fact summary emails and a visible bot joining calls, but these are incidental behaviors that users experienced as a lack of consent, not documented consent capabilities.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF
